about: The free sounds the game plays (Robin's picks, locked in 2026-10-20; the candidates he did not pick were removed that day, their story in git and docs/notes-archive.md): the sword's swing E and F, the shield going up (raise_h: raise_e and raise_f together), the block A, the hit on a tree A, on a rock A, a tree falling A (its lead-in trimmed so the crash lands as the trunk does). Gains by the ear-weighted loudness of the loudest 50 ms. Candidates for the talk window and the Lore Book (2026-10-22, Derek, SD's list from Kenney's RPG Audio, CC0): talk_open, talk_next (a to h), book_open, book_close (a to d), book_page (a to c), Robin's picks (2026-10-22) were made over by Derek, SD (out/sfx/ui: trimmed, varied, levelled) and are read from there; none of them is here any more.

raise_e.label: Kenney: a light knock of wood (the boards)

hit_v.label: The studio's: a snap and a slap on skin

heavyhit_v.label: The studio's, with body and crunch

chop_a.label: Wood pack: an axe in a tree

block_a.label: rubberduck: a knock, a slam, a hammer on wood

chop_v.label: The studio's: an axe into a trunk and into a log

treefall_v.label: The studio's: crack, creak, rush and the crash

logthud_v.label: The studio's: a log off the trunk

heavyhit_club_v.label: The studio's: the club's heavy hit

wave_v.label: The studio's: a wave on the beach

raise_h.label: Kenney: the straps and the boards together
